bullets.title: Bostitch Magnetic Staple Remover
bullets.note:
Who knew that the world needed a better, totally different staple remover? I
didn’t realize the headaches I had until I tried this little gizmo. Think of
adding roller wheels to luggage--it seems an obvious solution in retrospect.
The sign of a breakthrough design: you ask yourself “why didn’t someone think
of this earlier?”
